# Maven

> > Maven is a cohort-based learning platform offering expert-led courses in AI, product management, career development, negotiation, and professional skills from instructors at Google, Meta, Microsoft, and other leading companies.

Maven connects learners with practitioners from top tech companies and institutions like MIT, offering interactive courses focused on career advancement, technical interviews, AI mastery, go-to-market strategy, and leadership development. The platform emphasizes hands-on learning through cohort-based courses with live instruction and peer collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Cohort-based courses
- AI and machine learning
- Career advancement
- Tech interviews and job search
- Product management
- Negotiation skills
- Go-to-market strategy
- Professional development
- Leadership transition
- Data science
- Communication coaching
- Software engineering
- B2B strategy
- Design operations
- Market research

## AI & Data Science Courses

- [AI for Marketers](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-marketers): AI marketing courses featuring experts like Jamey Gannon & John Whalen
- [The Billion Person Focus Group® - AI-Powered Market Research](https://maven.com/abi-awomosu/the-billion-person-focus-group): AI-powered market research methodology by Abi Awomosu from Meta/Uber
- [AI Mastery for Admin Pros](https://maven.com/techsavvyassistant/ai-mastery-for-admin-pros): ChatGPT & Copilot training for admin professionals by Jessica McBride
- [AI-Enhanced Thinking & Decision-Making](https://maven.com/informivity/generative-ai-productivity): AI-enhanced cognition & decision workflows by Ross Dawson at Informivity
- [AIQ Intelligence Dojo 1: Analytical Partnership & Certification](https://maven.com/aiqninja/analyticalpartnership): AIQ certification & human-AI partnership by Dr. Layla Martin
- [Data Science for Business People](https://maven.com/howard-friedman/datascienceforbusiness): Data science fundamentals for business leaders by Friedman & Swaminathan

## Career Development & Interview Preparation

- [How To Master Tech Interviews And Control Your Career](https://maven.com/raphaelneves/mastering-tech-interviews): Tech interview prep course by Raphael Neves using S.T.R.I.V.E Framework
- [Stand Out in Job Interviews with a Career Walking Deck](https://maven.com/kkarenism/career-walking-deck-lab-for-job-interviews): Career Walking Deck system for job interviews by Karen K. Ngo
- [Transition from a Tech Practitioner to a Tech Executive](https://maven.com/solsol/practitioner-to-leader): Tech exec transition course for Data/AI professionals by Sol Rashidi
- [Accelerate Your PM Career](https://maven.com/crossing-career-chasms/accelerate-pm-career): Product management career development by Meta/Yelp PM Satish Mummareddy

## Product Management & Go-to-Market Strategy

- [Mastering B2B Go-to-Market for Growth](https://maven.com/anurag-wadehra/from-product-to-market): B2B GTM strategy & Product Market Growth Framework by Google/P&G expert
- [Succeeding in B2B Product Management](https://maven.com/jason-knight/b2b-product-management): B2B product management strategies by Khan & Knight
- [DesignOps Fundamentals](https://maven.com/designopsassembly/designops-fundamentals): Design operations playbook by DesignOps Assembly instructors

## Negotiation & Communication Skills

- [Negotiation Playbook for Entrepreneurs and Tech Careers](https://maven.com/negotiate-more/negotiation-playbook-for-tech-careers): Salary & compensation negotiation tactics by Craig dos Santos
- [Advanced Negotiation Skills for the Workplace](https://maven.com/gerta/negotiates): Workplace negotiation frameworks by MIT/Harvard-trained instructors
- [English Clarity for Internationally-trained Professionals](https://maven.com/speak-fluent/english-clarity-for-internationally-trained-professionals): English pronunciation & clarity course for professionals by Angela Chung
